Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points up so we can ensure the terms work well for both of us.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. Let me check with our finance team to see if we can accommodate a net-30 structure for this project, or if we can meet in the middle. I will get back to you on this shortly.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important to find a balance that is fair and equitable. I am happy to discuss specific adjustments to make it more reasonable while still protecting our business interests. Let’s schedule a brief call later this week to go over this in detail.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
